purpose: Apply only user-confirmed directed-road closures and recompute structural network performance.

execution_tiers.name: Deterministic topology closure
execution_tiers.claim: Structural efficiency and connectivity change after removing exactly the confirmed directed roads

execution_tiers.name: Demand-aware closure response
execution_tiers.claim: Capacity- and demand-aware redistribution, executed by a separate assignment tier when all fields are present

mathematical_formulation.perturbation: remove exactly the selected directed road records
mathematical_formulation.connectivity: change in weak-component count and largest weak-component size

primary_sources.citation: Jenelius, E., Petersen, T. and Mattsson, L.-G. (2006). Importance and exposure in road network vulnerability analysis. Transportation Research Part A, 40(7), 537-560.
Latora, V. and Marchiori, M. (2001). Efficient behavior of small-world networks. Physical Review Letters, 87, 198701.

verification_contract: Every removed road appears in the uploaded project and confirmed selection
Baseline and closure graphs use the same remaining nodes and impedance rule
Repeated inputs return identical connectivity and efficiency values
known_limitations: The base tier does not estimate demand redistribution or observed congestion
The closure is a user-defined counterfactual, not a hazard probability
Operational consequences require demand, capacity, facilities and independent validation
